planned_work.title: Generate reviewed public app catalog snapshot
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: From a disposable database approve a game, supply its reviewed hash-named HTML and export to a public static test origin; no API credentials in browser. Corrupt asset, tamper release and confirm no new snapshot replaces the last valid bytes; verify a disabled publisher disappears after next export.

planned_work.title: Suspend and restore publishers without deleting releases
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: With apps:approve change active publisher to disabled; check existing releases remain and new catalog hides apps. Confirm wrong/missing scope fails and reactivation restores only still-published apps.

planned_work.title: Paginate authenticated reviewed-only catalog
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Request catalog with apps:read, page limit 1, follow next until hasMore false; malformed after and limit return 422.

planned_work.title: Align configured legacy ZipRunner recipe with isolated Python checks
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Both source recipes use protected .venv, stable operator-facing recipe refresh guidance exists, and only a Windows ZipRunner log using setup_build_env.py/run_python_checks.py can validate target fix.

Validated after/limit cursor contracts prevent unbounded client pages and preserve reviewed-only projections.
Portable native-Path mocks for dependency bridge; tests now match Windows and POSIX path semantics; real SQLAlchemy registry tests preserved.
